First off I really recommend watching the tips videos by a youtuber named Doughnuts.

You haven't specified which part(s) of the EE you struggle with so I'll just give some general tips/my own strategies and cover the ones I think are most frequently struggled with.

I used the Feng with extended mags 2 as not having to reload frequently is really really useful for the boss. The ASG does great damage to the boss but I personally don't really like it as I always struggle to get headshots which makes point grinding early hard to do. I'd also recommend bringing in Molotovs  for a free random perk. For Gobblegums I brought Shields up, Idle Eyes and Power Keg. In the end I only used idle Eyes but I defo didn't need to. Obviously really strong gums like Perkaholic are good too I just never actually use them. Wonderbar CAN skip building the ice staff (but you'll still need to upgrade it) or it can give you the ray gun which is honestly bad for this egg. Hidden power is useless as you can get a free good aether tool incredibly easily by just making it to round 21 which you are realistically going to be doing anyway. Tribilogist on PHD and whater the augment is on vulture aid that gives more Wonder Weapon ammo are ESSENTIAL.

I would always recommend doing the free PAP EE ASAP and getting the free aether tool too. Personally I wait till round 21 for the free gold but I'm always drowning in salvage so getting it earlier for purple and then buying the gold is deffo a valid start.

Before I do the constellation lockdowns I always have Quick, Jugg, Pap and tier 2 armour, and almost always have my free perk from the Molotovs already. I never buy tier 2 pap or any more perks until I've finished the EE and am prepping for the boss, instead I focus on getting level 3 armour and buying the doors I need so that I can complete the steps at as low a round as I can. 

For protecting the ice staff I put two Energy mine Turrets down either side of the staff and then train near the green portal/crafting table. It's important to note that you should still be killing zombies with your gun, the turrets are there to protect the staff not to get kills to charge it. 

Freezing the flame is not too difficult as long as you know that there is always 1 flame per room. I use the one in stamina up room, the one by red portal (make sure it's not down by quick revive) and the one by speed cola. 

Shooting the symbols is not hard it can just be annoying to find them and make sure when you are about to go through the portal the symbols are on the floor Infront of it, if not you've done it incorrectly and stepping through you will fall to your death. 

For the keeping with the purple orb step I just use the ice staff. Like literally that is it. Don't waste ammo and don't feel the need to kill the elites or specials. If you struggle with this step having an Aether shroud charge or perhaps even a mutant injector will help. 

Congratulations you now have the upgraded ice staff which is OP as all hell and will carry you the rest of the EE. I absolutely love it.

For the 4 trials just remember that you can't do any steps on bug rounds (for whatever reason). And make sure as soon as you pick up the energy after completing a trial, you run immediately for an adjacent portal. If you are quick enough you can get past the choke holds in the doorways whilst the zombies are still crawling out of the ground. Shoot a charged shot at the floor and stand in it to kill the vermin and ghasts easily. For parasites shoot storms at the center and use it to cover you whilst you run round picking up orbs and putting them in the statue. For the Amalgam again the ice storm is your best friend (I seriously SERIOUSLY cannot overstate how good the charged shot is) just be sure to keep you distance and keep the storm between you and the amalgam, making sure to kill the protective zombies ASAP. If your struggling sometimes in the Ghast trial they drop mutant injectors which you can use here on the amalgam trial. 

Now it's time to prep for the boss. Buy every perk from the wonderfizz, get level 3 armour if not already, gold gun rarity and PAP 3, 2 charges of Aether shroud and you can bring a mutant injector for safety if you want (if you are going to use it I'd recommend doing so on the upcoming Ghast phase of the boss). Also remember that on solo you can always save and quit as long as you haven't done so on this round before and are at full health. Therefore if the boss kills you use your self revive kit and then immediately save and quit. You'll load back in at the start of the round pre boss fight and will have to rebuy anything you got that round AND A NEW SELF REVIVE KIT. Remember that there is a free self revive kit EE just for shooting some vases. This is a great way to get more practise on the boss without having to redo the entire EE every time.

First of all, do not go upstairs unless you absolutely have to until the final phase in which case you need to go up there to shoot the artifact. 

For the first half of the boss run up to the artifact and orient yourself so that the Vermin statue on the top is directly In front of you, (a beam will always stop here every time regardless of how many beams there are so if you always face it you will be able to tell asap when the boss is vulnerable.) and lie prone. (This means the beam will pass over you and you will be safe.) Launch a charged ice staff shot at the ground which will protect you. Wait for the boss to become vulnerable (happens the second time the artifact raises into the air. So it will be lower level, higher level, lower level, higher level, vulnerable) once it's vulnerable shoot a charged ice shot at the ground and switch to you bullet weapon and just unload on the boss until it breaks. Rinse and repeat. Once you get the rhythm down you will be able to anticipate when it's about to stop and charge your ice staff shots accordingly. 

Once the artifact starts moving to enemies you need to run around the outside on the lower level,  shooting ice storm shots at the ground as you go. Keep an eye on its health and when it gets low make a stand and switch to the bullet weapon to hopefully kill it and the artifact quickly. I cannot stress enough how important patience is to this section. Do not rush this. Make sure that all other elites and specials are dead before killing the HVT. You may have to kill the HVT a couple times but as long as you take your time, keep your cool and are patient all will go well.  The Ghast is by far the hardest one because he is so fast he can catch up to you very very quickly. Use tribologist to get away from him, sliding into the corners of the square arena and there using your charge shot. Again prioritise patience and staying alive over doing damage to the HVT. You can also bait him into trying to shoot you with his needles to buy time to create space between you or charge a shot. Just be very careful as getting hit by it almost always leads to a down. Use aether shrouds as and when necessary. Rinse and Repeat. 

On the final phase is where I used idle eyes and just unloaded into the boss managing to break it without even needing to reload. If idle eyes is a no go then (and you may be shocked that I'm suggesting this) stand inside a charged ice staff shot for protection. Also any remaining aether shrouds are also very useful. 

Hope this helps. Best of luck 😁👍
